mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months indicates monetary policy easing, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next five trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines >=0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and deceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflationary pressures, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL YoY >0.5% and INDPRO MoM < -0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in high-inflation regimes when FEDFUNDS rises >0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 850,000 units indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when HOUST falls below 850.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when INDPRO falls >0.5% MoM and UNRATE rises >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: In strong GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), a decline in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in strong GDP growth regimes when RSAFS declines >0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past six months indicates a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when PAYEMS declines by more than 100 (thousand persons) over six months.
